editorial:
Imagine getting a free house from a dad you never knew, only to find out it comes with a side of ancient demons. That is exactly what happens to Oliver, a college senior who just wants to finish school but ends up trapped in a nightmare. Once he opens a mysterious old book called a grimoire, he accidentally lets out a swarm of vampires and a very grumpy devil. The whole vibe feels like a scary campfire story come to life, mixing spooky witchcraft with fast-paced monster action that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

What really works here is how the tension builds up without feeling too slow. The acting is solid, and the special effects for the monsters look great. While some of the plot twists are a bit easy to guess, the final fight is a total blast. You should definitely watch this if you love movies where humans fight things that go bump in the night.
endingExplained: At the end, Oliver realizes the only way to stop the devil is to use the grimoire to seal the portal from the inside. In a big twist, he discovers his father didn't leave him the house by accident, but as a trap to keep the monsters locked away. Oliver manages to burn the book and banish the vampires, but he has to give up his own soul to lock the door forever, leaving him as the new guardian of the house.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves vampires and magic books.
